name: Sarkoth's Mangled Claw
summary: Across the southern bluffs of the Valley of Trials, Sarkoth's Mangled Claw bears the mark of a wounded hunter. Hana'zua's crushing blow scarred the scorpid's pincer before its venomous sting struck him down.

sections.title: A Trophy of Vengeance
sections.body: Hana'zua, a young Darkspear troll, met Sarkoth while hunting in the Valley of Trials. The massive scorpid's venomous stinger pierced his chest, leaving him bleeding beneath a nearby tree. Before the blow landed, Hana'zua crushed the beast's pincer. Its severed, battered claw proves Sarkoth has been slain. For the wounded hunter, that scar on the beast is proof his desperate strike left its mark, and a last hold on his warrior's honor as venom courses through his veins.

faq.answer: Sarkoth's pincer was crushed in a desperate duel with Hana'zua, a troll hunter. Though Sarkoth stung Hana'zua in the chest, the troll struck the beast before its claw could close around his leg.

Hana'zua asks for the claw. Badly wounded beneath a tree in the Valley of Trials, he fears he will die there. He wants Sarkoth slain so his honor is upheld; seeing the deed done steels him to endure until Gornek sends aid.

faq.q: Where did this claw come from?
faq.answer: The claw came from Sarkoth, a large, aggressive scorpid prowling the elevated plateau along the southern cliffs of the Valley of Trials in Durotar.

angles.text: As a troll, bringing the claw to Hana'zua gives a dying Darkspear kinsman some dignity. He learns his final strike scarred the beast before the end.
As a member of the Horde, claiming the trophy in the Valley of Trials marks an early test of courage and martial strength in Durotar's harsh wilds.
